_comment: The first bundle in this repository whose every fact was read first-hand.
ADR 0015 says a fact enters a published bundle because somebody read it in
the game or in the publisher's own disclosure; ADR 0016 makes that
falsifiable. Until this file, no bundle here carried a first-hand fact —
the only publishable ones were synthetic fixtures declaring AUTHORED_FIXTURE.
Every number below is transcribed from
docs/game-facts/punishing-gray-raven-research-disclosure.md, which is the
reading itself. Nothing here was checked against a guide, a wiki or an
aggregator, deliberately: the cross-check is only worth something if it
happens after the authoring rather than during it.
It is small, and the smallness is the finding. What was read and could not
be written down is listed under 'what is missing and why' in the note; the
three that cost the most were the Themed Construct pool (PityRule.hardAt is
an int and PGR draws it uniformly 80-100 per cycle), the weapon Overclock
and Harmony recipes (read off a weapon whose name was not recorded, and an
Upgrade must name its entity), and the currencies (Item.rarity is required
and a currency is not graded on any screen that was read).
2026-09-19: the weapon was named (Hear the Bell), so its recipes are rows;
the fodder item was named; and the first stage and shop row landed. One
currency, Simulation Score, turned out to be graded on a screen after all.
Later the same day: Cogs and Phantom Pain Scar were graded on shop and
reward tiles too, and Helentine: Lacrimosa went in whole except Awaken,
whose tiers are conditions rather than costs. Still refused: the Themed
Construct pool, every level and rank gate (Upgrade has no preconditions),
the Phantom Pain shop (a limit that never resets), score-scaled weekly
grants, and the currencies no screen has graded (Black and Rainbow Cards).
PGR records patches by name rather than number, so the label is a name.
label: Steering By Light
attribution: Punishing: Gray Raven is published by Kuro Game. These numbers were read from the English-language (Global) client, patch "Steering By Light", on 2026-09-18. Numbers and text only; no game assets.

provenance.detail: The research pool's own Basic Rules, Details, Switch and Drop Details panels, Punishing: Gray Raven Global (English) client, patch "Steering By Light", Commandant level 105, on the Selena: Pianissimo (Arrival Construct, 09/17-10/01) and Karenina: Effulgence (Themed Construct, 08/19-09/23) banners. Screenshots taken by the maintainer on 2026-09-18 and transcribed in a Claude Code session; no screenshot is committed, because game assets are not allowed in this repository.

The weapon Enhancement, Overclock and Harmony screens and the item detail cards behind them, same client, same patch, same account, same sitting. The Enhancement Cost picker was read with exactly one unit of fodder selected, which is where 'Obtained EXP 300' comes from.

The Select Equipment screen naming Hear the Bell (6-star, ATK 50 / CRIT 25, the same base stats the 2026-09-18 Enhance screen showed), the Weapon Enhancer IV item card, the Resources menu, the Simulated Battlefield stage screen and one run's Battle Results, the Simulation Score item card, the Simulation Shop's Material (both pages), Memory and Version Limited tabs, the reward screen from opening one stack of Overclock Material Box (beta), the Authority Level panel, and the Major Overclock Alloy, Weapon Overclock Core II and Memory Overclock Circuit II item cards. Same client and account, patch "Steering By Light". The run was read during a 2x event and its score halved on the maintainer's report that the event doubles it; the result tile itself is marked 'Double'. That the score is fixed per run and unmoved by Authority Level, and that the box opens into a fixed split, are the maintainer's reports from playing daily.

Helentine: Lacrimosa's Level Up screen at Lv 1 / 80 with one EXP Pod (M), (L) and (XL) selected in turn, her Evolution screen, and her four Awaken tiers; Liv: Limpidity's Infinitas orb-colour screen and the Ultima: Lacrimosa item card; the Memory Samantha's detail, Enhance (to 45) and Resonance screens, and the Memory Enhancement Cost picker with one Memory Enhancer IV selected; the Inver-Shard - Lacrimosa and Phantom Pain Scar cards and the Phantom Pain shop's shard tile. Same client and account, patch "Steering By Light". Also her Promote tab at every step from PRIVATE to HERO and her Skill screens (the leader skill's Unlock, the core passive's Level Up). That Level Up has no Cog cost, that she was pulled at S rank, and that every skill unlock costs the same as the one read are the maintainer's reports; their report that every skill level costs the same was contradicted by the Delusional Spin screens and the 1 -> 18 upgrade prompt, and is not relied on.

_comment: The Arrival Construct archetype, read on Selena: Pianissimo. Its sibling,
the Themed Construct archetype read on Karenina: Effulgence, is NOT here:
its guarantee is a value drawn uniformly between 80 and 100 and redrawn
on every S-Rank, and PityRule.hardAt is an int. Writing any one number
there would be inventing a rule the screen does not state.
Two further things on the same screen that the model has nowhere to put:
the guarantee is inherited by the next pool of the same type with a
pending Calibration included, where PityScope.BANNER_TYPE says only that
the bucket is the type; and the per-10 A-Rank-or-above floor is here but
both engines ignore floors below the headline by design.
No availability window: the dates 09/17 - 10/01 06:59 were read, the zone
they are in was not, and Availability takes instants. That is N20.
The stated overall S-Rank rate including the guarantee is 1.90%, which
does not reproduce from 0.50% and a wall at 60 (it computes 1.925%). The
note argues the 1.90% is a long-run outcome share rather than a per-pull
probability, which is why only the row the screen calls 'Base Drop' is
written as a base rate here.
One 4-star unit of weapon EXP fodder closes 300 EXP, read off the
Enhancement Cost picker with one unit selected. It reads 300 whether the
unit is an EXP material or a 4-star weapon, which is the single largest
simplification the reading produced: progressPerUnit is a function of the
fodder's rarity band alone.
The band is carried by consumesCategory rather than by minimumRarity,
because Fodder has no upper bound and the 5* / 4* / 1-3* filter buttons
on that screen imply the value moves with the band. Only the 4* figure
was read, so saying 'four stars and above give 300' would over-claim.
Weapon Enhancer IV carries that category since 2026-09-19, when its
name was read; before then the rule was inert rather than hung on an
invented item. The 4-star weapons the picker also offers are not items
here, so feeding a weapon is still outside the model.
costs is empty: the 340 000 Cogs on that screen was the side cost of the
whole 45-level enhancement, not a per-unit price.

fodder._comment: Memory EXP: one Memory Enhancer IV reads 'Obtained EXP 300' (estimated Lv 9) on the Memory Enhancement Cost picker — the same as the weapon's 4-star fodder, as the maintainer reports. Its own category, because it only feeds Memories.

_comment: Character Level Up, read on Helentine: Lacrimosa at Lv 1 / 80 with one
Pod of each size selected in turn: M reads +1000 (estimated Lv 10), L
+3000 (Lv 17), XL +20000 (Lv 37). No Cog or other side cost shows, and
the maintainer confirms there is none. The level curve itself is not
read beyond those three estimates, so a level goal cannot yet be turned
into an EXP demand.
30 Serum a run, open all day, no daily cap on runs (maintainer). One run
read: 164 Simulation Score on a tile marked 'Double', during an event
granting 10 doubled runs a day, so 82 is the base yield.
Declared rather than sampled, so no sampledRuns: the maintainer runs it
daily and reports the score fixed, and Authority Level (its panel read:
damage buffs and Super Armor, EXP 55 / 80 / 105 ... per level) does not
move the score per run. The doubling is an event, not the stage.
Opening a stack of ten Overclock Material Box (beta): one purchase
opened into 4 Major Overclock Alloy, 3 Weapon Overclock Core II and
3 Memory Overclock Circuit II, and the two already-tracked stacks moved
644 -> 648 and 379 -> 382 between readings, which agrees. The split is
fixed per purchase (maintainer). Written per ten because the purchase is
the unit read: per box it would be 0.4 / 0.3 / 0.3, which no one box gives.
Opening a stack of ten Overclock Material Box (alpha): 5 + 5 of two
3-star items. The reward screen shows icons only; that they are Minor
Overclock Alloy and Memory Overclock Circuit I was guessed from the
icons and confirmed by the maintainer. So the alpha box gives NO Weapon
Overclock Core I, and Hear the Bell's 28 of it have no source here.
Material Shop tab: 10 Weapon Enhancer IV for 262 Simulation Score, the
price covering the whole stack, and no purchase limit (maintainer), so
periodLimit is 0 and the period is inert. With the stage above, the
route is 30 Serum -> 82 Score, and 262 Score -> 10 x 300 EXP.
The shop's other rows were read and are left out on purpose: the
Overclock Material Boxes open into three unnamed 4-star materials
(3 + 3 + 4 from one stack of ten), and the Memory and Memory Shard rows
feed a system this bundle does not have yet.

Material Shop, second page: 15 Skill Points for 69 Simulation Score. No limit shown.

upgrades._comment: One Overclock step takes Hear the Bell's level range to its maximum of 45 (maintainer); the recipe is the one read on 2026-09-18 with the slider on Highest. The 340 000 Cogs is that screen's one Consume figure for the whole Lv 1 -> 45 advance, Enhance and Overclock together; it lands on this row because this row is the advance to 45, and Cogs had no item until 2026-09-19. The EXP half (24 000) is still not a demand anything can express. States are opaque labels for 'before' and 'after'.

Samantha's Overclock, read on her Enhance screen with the slider on Highest (to 45): 6 Major Overclock Alloy, 6 Memory Overclock Circuit II, 7 Minor Overclock Alloy, 10 Memory Overclock Circuit I, and 260 000 Cogs as the screen's one Consume figure for the whole advance, as on Hear the Bell's row. The EXP half (18 000) has no demand to live in yet. Unlike the weapon's, every material here has a Simulation Shop route.
Harmony Lv 1 only. Levels 2 and 3 show 'Not available' and hide their cost, so they are absent rather than guessed.

_comment: Promote, the whole ladder, read one Rank Up screen at a time up to HERO,
'Max Level Reached': thirteen steps, Cogs only, 542 500 in total.
States count steps; the ranks they cross are PRIVATE (step 1), SERGEANT
(2-3), ELITE (4-6), TASK FORCE (7-9) and ACE (10-13), ending at HERO.
Every step is also gated on a level — 2, 10, 20, 30, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60,
65, 70, 75, 80 — and Upgrade has costs but no preconditions, so the gates
are here in prose only. Step 11's 'Lv.70' was read through the weapon
model overlapping the text; the sequence around it agrees.
Evolve S -> SS: 30 Inver-Shard - Lacrimosa in total (maintainer); one
node inside it was read at 'Consume 2 / 9'. One row, because the nodes
between are unread. Shards come from duplicates and from the Phantom
Pain shop: 'Available: 30', 10 Phantom Pain Scar each at '66% Off' (was
30), and 20 each for the next 20 (maintainer). That shop is NOT a row:
its limit never resets, and Shop.period has no value meaning never.

upgrades._comment: Unlocking the leader skill, Leader - Fading Fern: 3 Skill Points and 25 000 Cogs, read on its Unlock button. The maintainer reports every skill unlock costs the same.

_comment: Skill levels: one curve, written once per named skill, cap 18. Read:
1 -> 2 is 1 Skill Point + 2 000 Cogs on four skills (Astral Armament,
Seeker System, Withering Spiral, Amplifier); 2 -> 3 and 3 -> 4 are 1 +
3 000 and 1 + 4 000 on Delusional Spin; and the level-to-max prompt on
Seeker System at Lv 1 reads 1 -> 18 (Max) for 44 Skill Points and
206 000 Cogs, the same total an earlier prompt showed.
4 -> 18 is DERIVED, not read: the prompt's total minus the three steps
read one at a time, 41 SP and 197 000 Cogs. It is one row because the
curve between 4 and 18 is unread, and because the planner refuses a
state two routes reach, so a 1 -> 18 shortcut beside the single steps
would break every goal on the skill. That every basic, special and
common-effect skill shares this curve is the maintainer's report, which
the four 1 -> 2 readings and the two identical prompts support. An
earlier report that every level costs 1 + 2 000 was contradicted by
the screens and is not used.
All seven of her basic, special and common-effect skills are named and
here; Blight Excision [Blue Orb] and Link Dissolution [Basic Attack] read 1 -> 2 at 1 + 2 000 too.

upgrades._comment: Vestige [SS Rank Passive Skill], Evolution Effect page: Unlock costs 2 Skill Points + 20 000 Cogs, read on its button. Its Lv 1 is 'Unlocked at S5 Rank' and its Lv 2 'at SS Rank' — gates on Evolve, which Upgrade cannot express, and the maintainer cannot reach them to read what follows the unlock.
